findings: Home content: Flutter app com.webos.app.home with layouts home_lg.xml (ShelfView: globalactionbuttons, herobanner, qcardList, appList, recommendedShelf, recentApps, editAppList). Shelf list 'ai_home_info' (HOME_SH_QCARD/APPS/RECOMMENDED/LGCHANNELS/SHOPPING/LIFEONSCREEN/AMAZONPRIME/CONTENT_PREVIEW/EDITORSPICK/LGRECOMMEND_*) is cloud data via sdx sdp_home and tlamp_secure (mock json is bundled); apps/launch points from homelaunchpoints and applicationmanager; there is no static home.xml content.

Home ad/promotion elements: hero banner and Inline banner via luna admanager (requestBannerInfoWithoutContextIndex, sendImpressionTracker, handleClickBanner, launchCMPApp); recommended-shelf ad slots Portal/HomeRecommend@Main (index 3,4) and Portal/HomeSecondLGShop1@Main; SponsorLabelWidget 'Sponsored'; AdShelf and WeeAdShelves; 'Not Advertising Target Country' gate. On this set general.homePromotion=off so the hero is suppressed ('promotion is disabled'); recommended/ad shelves are still requested if generalTerms allowed (true).

Usage logging in Home: NL_* event names (HERO_SHOWN/CLICKED, HOME_SHOWN, SHELF_CONTENT_LAUNCH, RECENTS_*, QCARD_CLICKED, TOP_GLOBAL_BUTTON_CLICKED2, APP_LAUNCH...); Music/Home Office/New&Hot/Voice use the same NL_* pattern. Treat as PmLog/netlog records [INFERENCE: uploaded by LG logging services].

Settings on this TV: general.homePromotion=off, general.adCookie=on, option.livePlus=off, general.screenSaverAd=off, option.screenSaverArtEnabled=off, country USA, EULA generalTermsAllowed=true but voice2/additionalData/acr/marketingOn/customAd all false (so Alexa, AI add-ons and personalised ads are gated off). profile.idleApp=Home, profile.home.topItem=qCard, profile aiRecommendation absent.

Home opening: Home key release calls launchHomeApp (systemUi.js handleHomeKeys); pressing Home while Home is shown closes it; Home key hold ~2.5 s runs the magnifier controller; Back on the first Home screen opens Recent Lists (Home i18n text); Home overlays the running app (layout windowType=overlay). Senior/Wee/LG variants selected by com.webos.app.home.uiStyle (LG here) and seniorMode profile (support=false). configd already has handleLumaHome keyfilter first in the chain.

Home Hero/shelves require network, generalTerms EULA, promotion setting; shopping/LG Channels/Amazon/Content-preview shelves use CONTENTMINER (applicationManager getContents), i.e. content from installed apps. Live PIP (focusAutoLaunch) can auto-play an LG Channels live tile in the shelf.

Screensaver: flutter app already running as a process; variants are chosen by checkScreenSaverType (ad if screenSaverAd on and ad assets exist, Gallery+ if enabled and logged in, else default particles/clock). Ads come from admanager slot Portal/ScreenSaver@Main with a Sponsored label and impression tracking; videoads (screenSaver window) loads LG Channels video ads when lgchannels.isVideoScreenSaverEnabled is true (false here). screensaver also calls pqcontroller reduceLuminance and tvpower turnOnScreen.

TAS mode: com.webos.tas.home / screensaver / aiplatform D-Bus services start the same flutter-client binaries as boot-time background services; missing /var/luna/preferences/tas_*_enabled flags mean they run as normal apps. running.json/ps show Home and Screensaver processes alive, plus lgchannels, netflix, youtube, livetv prelaunched.

Always Ready (AoD): pinnedAppsOnAODBoot = alibaba.genie, amazon.alexapr, voice, google.assistant, yandex.alice, aiplatform. Gallery+ (lifeonscreen, appCategory aod) provides AoD art; atelier (also aod) only on rollable models (supportScreenType=atelier; this set none). tvpower AoD reasons exist in config but no aod settings row present; availability on this C4 not verified.

com.webos.app.discovery (Apps tile) is not in /usr/palm: it is an OTN-updated shell (v10.0.7 at /mnt/otncabi) that posts device info (sdx headers, minus auth fields) to https://<env>.app.lgwebostv.com/discovery_2024/discovery.html with page=store; the whole store (featured, categories, promoted apps, search, install) is server-rendered web content. Premium does the same to lgrecommends.lgappstv.com/discovery_2016 page=premium. New & Hot and LG Channels are likewise thin shells over cloud pages/APIs (lgchhomeapp.lgtvcommon.com).

Voice stack: mic key -> voiceconductor setInputEvent (hold, keyType thinQtv) -> voiceagent QML bar (sysuicompmgr) then voice native app (results, Sponsored keywords, keyboard launchMode vkb) or AI Concierge/aiplatform; Back/Exit while voiceagent runs is routed to it. aiplatformsupport owns Voice ID and settings pages; voiceweb/dangbei/yandex/alexa are web overlays for other assistants (alexa needs voice2 EULA).

Unreachable/irrelevant here: seniorhome (seniorMode off), atelier (not rollable), similarlist (country must be ITA), dangbei-overlay (China), yandex.alice (Russia), buddy (KakaoTalk/Korea), videoads (video screensaver disabled), ftmsinfo (no BLE FTMS gear). quicklinkcopilot has no UI of its own.
